subject: Texas AI Docket, Carousel No. 9, August 27th, 2026, Two releases. Neither names a room.
body:
Two releases. Neither names a room.

Carousel No. 9, August 27th, 2026

Shipped at 6.86. Merged to main at 2b4526fc.

This run merged to main on green CI, so every image and file below is served from main.

It did not merge on the first try, and the reason is worth a minute.

This run read its own gate suite at line 84 of an eventual 269 and recorded a pass. The first FAIL was at line 100. Ten of 120 steps had failed. Nothing about a wall of ok lines looks partial, which is the whole trap. A suite's verdict is its exit code and its final summary line, never the absence of failures in however much of the log exists when you look.

CI then failed on build and browser-read. Both were stale gates rather than defects in the deck. deck_preview caps at two sentences with no word floor, so this deck's article card previewed as six words. And the county citation test asserted the construction register fallback as though it were the rule, when this run's own ten admissions gave Dallas and Denton place pages and the citation correctly moved to the better link.

Both live in human-owned files, so they went out as pull request no. 212, merged, and came back through a merge of main. The ownership map held under pressure and cost one extra pull request, which is the trade it exists to make. The earlier diagnosis that checks could not be dispatched was also wrong. A push to a branch with an open pull request fires pull_request: synchronize and starts the run.

PANELSIX SCORING ROUNDS. See the run record. The deck was refused three times.

What degraded

  • THE RUN CALLED ITS OWN GATE SUITE GREEN WHILE IT WAS RED, by reading the log before it had finished being written. Ten of 120 steps had failed. CI caught both real failures. It is written up as GATE_LESSONS 69.
  • The scanner's daily ceiling was NOT checked. No Supabase connector is available to this session, so the query the routine specifies had nowhere to run. Nothing is known about today's scan count, the cap or any failures.
  • Per slide pixel critics were not spawned as separate agents. The showrunner ran that pass itself, opening every frame at full size and at feed size, and the panel of three scorers then read the pixels independently. The flow critic ran as specified.
  • The primary source share on /sources/ was read BEFORE this run's ten admissions landed, so the figure in the run record is a floor rather than the closing number.
  • THE PANEL WAS USED AS A DESIGN LOOP, which is the run's own biggest failure and the owner said so mid-run. Six scoring rounds, eighteen judge reports. The rubric's cap is five and its own prose says a panel is a check on a deck the run already believes is finished. This run shipped half-considered frames into three judges and let them find what a careful pass would have found for nothing. The next session's job is improving the agents that build the deck.
  • TWO FRAMES SHIP AGAINST THEIR OWN DECLARED TECHNIQUE and both are recorded as misses in ledger/carousel/artwork.json rather than described as met. Frame 5's cut reads as an emboss rather than an aperture, which this deck's own law 3 forbids, in the largest type it prints. Frame 9's stencil is square to the camera rather than projected onto the floor plane.
  • THE MEMBERSHIP TEST BEHIND THE COUNT OF THIRTEEN IS CRUDE IN BOTH DIRECTIONS and the deck now says only what the test computes rather than narrating a relation it never tested. compute.py emits ask_evidence per member so this is auditable: 10 of 13 carry both the ask word and the subject word in one sentence, and the three that do not are named.
  • TWO SOURCES COULD NOT BE REACHED, so two things a reader would want are absent rather than guessed. The Capitol listing names room E1.012 and no building. The Texas Register archive returned 403 to two fetch paths after serving the same run earlier, so how a written comment on Project 58482 is filed is not on the deck.

Named here rather than left out. A run that quietly ships less than it planned teaches nobody anything.

Post this

Upload the PDF to LinkedIn as a document, title it Two releases. Neither names a room., paste the post copy under it, then paste the first comment within a minute of posting.

carousel.pdf   contact sheet   the article   the site

1. The post copy

Neither release names an acting public body.

The Governor's office announced the Austin plant on August 19th, 2026, and Amazon's own release carries the same siting. Both put it at 300 to 500 jobs in manufacturing and engineering. Austin's mayor is quoted inside Amazon's own release saying "Amazon asked for no economic incentives, no public money".

Thirteen items on this record name a Texas city or county as the decider. Each record names a data center or a large load beside a tax break, a moratorium or an incentive. Twelve counties.

Written comment on the utility commission's proposed large load rule closes September 4th under Project 58482.

Should a siting this size come with a public meeting, whether or not anyone asked for money?

#TravisCounty #Project58482 #TexasManufacturing

Notes

THE RECORD. The worklist was four items on the two day leash and all four are re-verified. Two claims were corrected. tx-2026-0072 cited an open meeting that has been held and has come off the commission's rolling feed, so it now cites the December 17th meeting the audit's own filed schedule ends on. tx-2026-0090 quoted the National Science Foundation with the sentence cut short and a full stop the source does not have, and it now runs to the end. TEN DECISIONS WERE ADMITTED and the record holds 91 items and 432 claims. Amazon's Austin robotics siting, two National Science Foundation laboratory awards, a five year robotics centre at UT Austin, Denton's data centre moratorium resolution, the RELLIS abatement reassignment, the House charge on artificial intelligence against fraud, UT Southwestern grading clinical exam notes by machine, the Texas Politics Project's August poll, and Austin City Council's Item 61 taken up today. ONE THING WORTH A MINUTE OF YOUR TIME. tx-2026-0089 reached the published record citing four claims whose only source sat under capitol.texas.gov/tlodocs/, which robots.txt disallows for every agent. Nothing between the seed and the ledger checks a claim's url against the crawl boundary, so an item can be published that this project may never re-fetch and is therefore stale by construction. It is rewritten around the Speaker's own charge document on house.texas.gov, whose robots.txt disallows nothing, and the charge text is identical. The GAP is unfixed and is written up as a proposal. BOTH INSTRUMENTS ARE GREEN and nothing in either lane was touched. The scanner's daily ceiling could not be checked because no Supabase connector is available to this session. THE BACKLOG held steady at three, which the routine calls acceptable. THE DECK TOOK SIX SCORING ROUNDS AND WAS REFUSED THREE TIMES. That is the honest headline and it is a failure of the machine rather than of the judges. Round one was a unanimous refusal. Round two returned three hard fails, all from the integrity lens. Round three returned one, and it was the SAME claim as round two's, still standing on a surface the repair had not reached. Round four returned two, one of which was itself refuted against the fetched bytes. Round five returned two more. Every one of them was worked rather than argued, except that single refutation. THE RECURRING SHAPE, named by a judge in round three and true in every round after it: a repair lands on one surface and not its twin. It happened inside the pair of guard functions written to stop it. The guards now carry three word lists rather than one, read the published surfaces rather than a literal inside the code, and a second guard runs the check the other way round and fails the build if a declaration names a sentence no surface prints. Both new guards were proven red against the exact defects that shipped. WHAT THE PANEL FOUND THAT NOTHING ELSE COULD. Frame 5's filter had never executed in any round, because its id collided with the SVG element carrying it, and the source read like a working filter chain the whole time. Frame 4's declared focal measured near chance and the machine had already reported it. Three separate probes were measuring properties the defect left alone. WHAT THE PANEL SHOULD NOT HAVE HAD TO FIND. Two frames without their own declared technique. A membership test narrated four different wrong ways. A label butted into its own recess. Those are builder's work and the owner's instruction is to fix the builders rather than keep paying judges to catch them.

This is a draft. Nothing was sent. The deck merged to main on green CI, so every link here resolves against main and the deck is ready to post.
